rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that produces the opposite of its intended benefit.

example.english: Cutting staff to save money turned out to be counterproductive.
example.traditional: 為咗慳錢而減少人手，結果適得其反。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 haan1 cin2 ji4 gaam2 siu2 jan4 sau2 git3 gwo2 sik1 dak1 kei4 faan2

rows.note: Use this when an attempted helpful action instead creates extra trouble or becomes more hindrance than help.

example.english: You tried to help me tidy the room, but it was counterproductive and made the room even messier.
example.traditional: 你想幫我執房，點知幫倒忙，搞到間房更加亂。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 bong1 ngo5 zap1 fong2 dim2 zi1 bong1 dou2 mong4 gaau2 dou3 gaan1 fong2 gang3 gaa1 lyun6

rows.note: Use this when continued efforts to help keep making the situation worse.

example.english: They kept revising the report to help, but it was counterproductive and only made it worse.
example.traditional: 佢不停幫手改份報告，點知越幫越忙，份報告仲衰咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 ting4 bong1 sau2 goi2 fan6 bou3 gou3 dim2 zi1 jyut6 bong1 jyut6 mong4 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 seoi1 zo2
